content.text: Bed-leaving is really common at this age. Try a calm, boring "return to bed." Keep your bedtime routine short and predictable, with the same few steps in the same order. Then, each time they get up, walk them back with almost no talking and no eye contact, every time. The point is that getting up is never more interesting than staying in bed. A "one more hug, then I'll see you in the morning" line before lights out can head off a lot of the curtain calls.
